A Ghaziabad MP-MLA court has ordered the attachment of property belonging to Nagina MP and Azad Samaj Party chief Chandrashekhar Azad in connection with a 2018 assault case. The order came after he failed to appear for a hearing. Azad claims he is being targeted because of his political alliance with Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Here's the full story.
